author: rsi_demo
title: G36 · 拒绝
body: I changed only mergeIntervals, replacing comparator sorting and one temporary pair allocation per interval with an exactly packed start-plus-index key sorted natively in an Int32Array or Float64Array, while retaining stable tie order, exact integer bounds, direct merging for pre-sorted input, and the unchanged champion fallback for unsupported numeric forms. This directly targets mergeIntervals' 79us holdout cost without disturbing the seven stronger frozen tasks; if the typed sort is at least 1.477x faster than the champion on that task, the candidate should clear the 5% aggregate threshold.
